source._comment: LIVE 2026-10-21 (Sam: 'Washington state has started reporting data'). The SoS Ballot Return Statistics page embeds a Power BI publish-to-web report (US Gov cloud; resource key from the embed's r= parameter; the Iowa gov cluster answers, the Virginia one returns 401). wa_update queries its public API (oh_update.PowerBI): Ballot Status Files (one row per returned ballot: County, Ballot Status Accepted/Received/Rejected, Received Date Only), Voters (VotersInElection by county = ballots mailed), AgeRange (returned ballots by age, by county), Former Election Data (the 2022 general, ballotstatus202211.csv, by received date) and Date Refresh (last refresh, Pacific). Returned = all statuses = the dashboard's '# TotalReturned' (10/20 5:25 PM: 337,155 = 312,519 accepted + 22,678 received + 1,958 challenged, of 5,154,545 voters). The UF Lab's WA row (statewide only) uses accepted (312,519).
